general_information.name: UH… IT’S ROBERT MILLER. THAT’S THE NAME ON MY DOCUMENTS, I BELIEVE.

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly I’ve had this sort of blah loss of interest — and I’ve been more tired than usual, kind of pulling back from people, and sleep has been off.
current_concerns.goals: I’d like to enjoy life again, really. And stay active if I can.

medications.current_medications:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: It’s carbidopa-levodopa.; Dose: 25/100 mg, one tablet three times daily.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2024.; Side Effects: Occasionally nausea.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes… there are others, but let me think. I have latanoprost eye drops.; Dose: One drop in each eye nightly.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2021.; Side Effects: None known.
Medication 3: Name Or Description: Yes, one more — allopurinol.; Dose: 100 mg daily.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2019.; Side Effects: None known.

medical_history.medical_conditions: Well, there are a few, and I’m trying to keep them straight… Parkinson’s disease, diagnosed in 2024. And I also had prostate cancer, though that’s in remission now.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My granddaughter.; Diagnosis Or Condition: ADHD.; Additional Details: She was diagnosed at age 9.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Wine.; Quantity or frequency: Monthly.; Duration: Minimal.

education_employment_legal_history.highest_education: I’ve got a bachelor’s degree… and I was a teacher.

personal_history.early_childhood: Born and grew up, and that’s about as much as I can say there.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: School mostly… and then I became a teacher. That’s the main thing I remember clearly from that time.
personal_history.future_goals: To enjoy life, and manage the illness.
